newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian rupee slips on aggressive RBI dlr buying.
newsitem.headline: Indian rupee slips on aggressive RBI dlr buying.

text.p: The Indian rupee slipped against the dollar on Friday afternoon after aggressive intervention by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI), dealers said.
"They hit at 35.78 levels," said a dealer at a foreign bank.
The rupee slided to 35.79/80 from 35.77/78 opening.
"There were quotes even at 35.80/81," said a dealer.
He said the highest dollar deals on Friday were at 35.805.
Spot rupee was quoting at 35.792/800 in latest deals.
